description: This file is a Node.js script for profiling memory usage of extension entry points in an OpenClaw project. It imports Node.js core modules to manage processes, filesystem, and OS operations, and provides functions for argument parsing, running profiling cases, and generating reports tailored to extension memory usage analysis.

methods.name: printHelp
methods.description: Outputs usage instructions and help message for the profiling script.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments and options for customizing the profiling run.

methods.name: parseMaxRssMb
methods.description: Extracts maximum Resident Set Size in MB from stderr output.

methods.name: summarizeStderr
methods.description: Provides a summarized preview of stderr output, limited to a specified number of lines.

methods.name: runCase
methods.description: Runs a child process to execute a profiling test case with specific parameters, returning resources used and execution status.

methods.name: buildImportBody
methods.description: Constructs a string of import statements for extension files to be evaluated in a profile run.

methods.name: findExtensionEntries
methods.description: Locates and retrieves all built extension entry points from the 'dist/extensions' directory.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The main async function orchestrating the profiling process, argument parsing, setup, executing baseline and extension tests, and generating the report.
